mission: Publish independently reviewed NIST catalog definitions and explicit type taxonomy

topics: remaining NIST algorithms, data structures and associated definitions

source_policy: NIST is publisher of dictionary definitions. These are secondary descriptions, not original invention or experimental evidence.
notes: Entire catalog enumerated, not a handpicked volume cutoff. Existing labels, aliases and duplicate labels excluded. Capture/extraction gaps remain explicit in completion audit. Neutral metadata does not certify acceptance or current frontier standing. Taxonomy uses only explicit dictionary type headers. Revision 2 is the supported subset of revision 1, with each selected canonical record, source and support span unchanged. Failed or uncertain records and their taxonomies remain in the retained original batch and explicit repair queue. This revision does not claim those entries complete.
